metadata.article_title: Penalty for contravention of regulations under section 118.

article.title: Penalty for contravention of regulations under section 118.
article.content:
177APenalty for contravention of regulations under section 118.

Section 177A  ·  Chapter XIII  ·  page 100 of the Act
(1) Whoever contravenes the regulations made under section 118 shall, for the first contravention be issued a warning recorded in such manner as may be prescribed by the Central Government, and for any second or subsequent contravention with penalty which shall not be less than five hundred rupees, but may extend to one thousand rupees.
(2) Notwithstanding anything contained in sub-section (1), if any contravention of regulations made under section 118 is also an offence punishable with penalty or fine under any other provision of this Act, the penalty or fine imposed only under such other provision shall be applicable.]
